title: Microsoft Copilot: CSV and TSV files as knowledge sources in Copilot Notebooks
notes: claim 25: fix was 1287 characters, cut to 1200
summary: The briefing incorrectly says no automation is documented for the Notebooks creation policy. Microsoft documents a preview Microsoft Graph operation that can apply that setting at tenant scope, subject to restrictions. The feature description and rollout match the roadmap and Microsoft's notice, but some citations and qualifications also need correction.

claims.claim: Copilot Notebooks in OneNote now accept CSV and TSV files as knowledge sources alongside existing documents.
claims.quote: We are introducing support for using CSV and TSV files as knowledge sources in Microsoft Copilot Notebooks. This enhancement allows users to add structured lists and tabular data directly to notebooks alongside existing document types.

claims.where: Why it matters; Governance guidance; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: The notice does not name the control for allowing Copilot to reason over CSV and TSV files.
claims.quote: The feature will be enabled automatically for tenants that already allow Copilot to reason over CSV and TSV files. No additional configuration will be required.

claims.claim: No Microsoft Learn page describing CSV and TSV references in Copilot Notebooks was found.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Copilot Notebooks" "CSV" "TSV"'; '"569210" "CSV" "Notebooks"'. Read cpcn-admin-configuration, cpcn-requirements, cpcn-storage and search excerpts for Copilot release notes and CSV connector; none described this feature.

claims.claim: The control is in Microsoft 365 Apps admin center under Customization > Policy Management > policy configuration > Choose the scope > Configure Settings > Create and view Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks.
claims.quote: Select Customization from the left pane. Select Policy Management. Create a new policy configuration or edit an existing one. From the Choose the scope dropdown list, choose either All users or select the group
claims.fix: Keep the path. Add https://learn.microsoft.com/deployoffice/admincenter/overview-cloud-policy to sources: it explicitly identifies config.office.com as the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center; the cited control page supplies the remaining steps and setting.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls table and prose
claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no API for the Cloud Policy setting that controls Copilot Pages and Notebooks creation.
claims.quote: These resources also support remediation and applyOnce. The 20 Copilot resources are Office Cloud Policy Service (OCPS) settings. TCM supports these settings only in tenant-level policies in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center.
claims.fix: Replace controls[0].api with kind 'graph', call 'POST /beta/admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors', docs 'https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/api/configurationmanagement-post-configurationmonitors?view=graph-rest-beta', and update the rendered API cell. Add to the row note: 'Preview automation uses mode=applyOnce and an inline baseline resource with resourceType=microsoft.copilot.copilotpagesnotebooks, resourceVersion=1 and properties.value="0" to disable or "1" to enable. Global service only; tenant-level policies only, and the target setting must not be configured in any group-level policy. The calling app needs delegated ConfigurationMonitoring.ReadWrite.All, the TCM service principal needs delegated CopilotPolicySettings.ReadWrite, and the signed-in user needs AI Administrator. Microsoft Graph beta APIs are not supported for production applications.' Replace the final sentence of Governance controls with 'Microsoft documents preview Microsoft Graph TCM automation for the tenant-level Copilot Pages and Notebooks policy, subject to the restrictions in the table.' Cite the operation page, https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/utcm-copilot-resources#copilotpagesnotebooks-r…

claims.where: controls[0].governs and note; Risk assessment; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Create and view Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks governs creation and integration of Pages and Notebooks as a whole.
claims.quote: IT administrators can control creation and use of Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks through Cloud Policy settings. Disabled: Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks creation and integration aren't available to the users.

claims.claim: The creation policy's default is Enabled.
claims.quote: Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks creation | Cloud Policy: Create and view Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks | Enabled

claims.claim: The Cloud Policy control can target all users in the tenant or a group.
claims.quote: From the Choose the scope dropdown list, choose either All users or select the group for which you want to apply the policy.

claims.claim: A policy change takes up to 90 minutes when policy configurations already existed.
claims.quote: If there were existing policy configurations before the change, the change takes up to 90 minutes to be reflected.

claims.claim: A policy change takes up to 24 hours when no policy configurations previously existed.
claims.quote: If there were no policy configurations before the change, the change takes up to 24 hours to be reflected.
